scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Ice melting
experiments.focus: Show a simple change of state from solid to liquid.
student_observations: The ice piece gets smaller over time.
The model changes from solid to liquid.
experiments.teacher_note: Useful for introducing physical change and phase transitions.

experiments.title: Mixture review 3
experiments.focus: Compare a dissolving solid with a cloudy mixture.
student_observations: Sugar can disappear into the liquid.
Different solids behave differently in water.
experiments.teacher_note: A simple review before moving to separation ideas.

experiments.title: Salt versus sugar dissolving
experiments.focus: Compare two common solids that both dissolve but may be discussed differently in class.
student_observations: Both solids can dissolve in water.
The model can show different amounts or speeds.
Solutions can still look clear even when the solute changes.
experiments.teacher_note: Good bridge between everyday examples and solution language.

experiments.title: Soap and water bubbles
experiments.focus: Introduce the idea that additives can change the behavior of water.
student_observations: Water behavior changes when soap is added.
Some substances affect surfaces and mixing.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep this as a visual, non-technical concept activity.

experiments.title: Evaporation and residue concept
experiments.focus: Show the idea that a solvent can leave behind a dissolved solid.
student_observations: The water amount can decrease in the model.
The dissolved solid can remain visible later.
Solutions can change as the solvent leaves.
experiments.teacher_note: A safe conceptual example for separation and recovery ideas.

experiments.title: Solution review 3
experiments.focus: Review which materials form clear solutions and which stay as mixtures.
student_observations: Some solids make the water cloudy.
Clear solutions and cloudy mixtures are not the same.
experiments.teacher_note: Good for revision before a classroom quiz or recap.
